title: Concept: Child process executed with a shell-free API but unvalidated program path in zig — review required
description: In zig, a child process is prepared. Because no shell is involved, quoting is not the issue; instead the executable selection and the argument contents are. A program path built from configuration or input allows an attacker to choose what runs even without shell metacharacters.
applicability: zig services and CLI tools that call external programs.
risk: Execution of an unintended program or argument set; MEDIUM severity.
